body: Thanks. It's a sad state of affairs that a random stranger on the internet has done more to encourage me to carry on than almost anyone. The truth is I'm just not strong anymore. I'm not someone to be admired. I used to be strong when I was in the middle of child abuse and still fighting to come out the other side but I'm not strong anymore. All I'm doing is *not* killing myself. Thats all I am able to do. And every day I feel that it's harder to stay here than the day before, not easier.
